$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFGB (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Mulhouse - Habsheim

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

preferredQfuReason: preferred QFU 199, due to noise pollution
notes: Simultaneous use of RWY is prohibited.
Unpaved RWY 16/34 reserved for home-based ULM.
Paved RWY reserved for ACFT whose reference distance is less than 800 m.

Pilots' attention is drawn towards the proximity of BALE-MULHOUSE AD and associated IFR intense activity, of BALE CTR and of TMA 1 BALE (lower limit 1000 ft ASFC); so the transit routes from / to BALE-MULHOUSE AD via N and NE points.
The attention of the pilots is drawn to the proximity between the helipad of Moenchsberg hospital and WH point.
Possible damages due to animals on unpaved RWY.
In case of sector South wind, watch out for the aircraft on ILS approach RWY 15 at BALE-MULOUSE.
Captive balloons (NR 960): see ENR 5.3 Preferred QFU: 199° due to noise pollution.
TKOF at QFU 199°: preferentiel lining up at RWY threshold.
After TKOF left hand turn before crossing of the highway, if possible.
TKOF QFU 159° and LDG QFU 339°: do not cross RWY 02/20 extended centerline.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Arrivals and departures conditions for motorized ACFT: A/A compulsory for arrivals 1 minute before overhead of reporting point: NH for arrivals by the North; WH for arrivals by the West.
ARRIVALS: from South-West and West via WH; from North and East via NH.
DEPARTURES RWY 20: to the West, after initial climb, avoid the Habsheim village, then South of Habsheim heading to the West via SH.; to the East and the North via EH.

DEPARTURES RWY 02: to the West, down wind, avoiding Habsheim village, then South of Habsheim heading to the West via SH.; to the East and the North via EH; to the North via PH for based ULMs and glider tow- aircraft.
